events.title: Kickstarter Live Now!!
events.summary: This is super important: Beyond The Frame's Kickstarter is live now! In order to turn Beyond The Frame into a full and polished game, we need to commit to working on it full time. And to do that, we need your help.We're putting everything we can into the game. We love seeing the game evolve and how the players have responded with every update.So if you want to play a full-length version on Beyond the Frame, please support us via our Kickstarter campaign!https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/backy

events.title: Kickstarter Announcement
events.summary: Hello Dreamers! Big News: Beyond The Frame launches its Kickstarter on October 18th at 7pm ET / 4pm PT. We’re a small indie team (two dudes with computers), so this campaign is how we turn the demo into a full game. If you’re excited about Beyond The Frame, here’s how you can help right now:Hit the ‘Notify me on launch’ button on our Kickstarter page.
